nodes.label: Risk-Reward Ratio Diagram
nodes.description: Line chart titled 'Почему Risk/Reward важнее, чем точность прогноза' showing expected value (матожидание) per trade at 1% risk vs win rate (20-80%). Four curves: R:R=1:1 (red), R:R=1:2 (orange), R:R=1:3 (green), R:R=1:5 (blue). Demonstrates that higher R:R ratios yield positive expectancy even at low win rates.

nodes.label: Win Rate (% прибыльных сделок)
nodes.description: X-axis variable in risk-reward chart: win rate percentage from 20% to 80%

nodes.label: Expected Value per Trade (Матожидание)
nodes.description: Y-axis variable in risk-reward chart: expected value percentage at 1% risk per trade, ranging from -100 to +350

nodes.label: R:R = 1:1 curve
nodes.description: Red line showing break-even at 50% win rate for 1:1 risk-reward ratio

nodes.label: R:R = 1:2 curve
nodes.description: Orange line showing break-even around 33% win rate for 1:2 risk-reward ratio

nodes.label: R:R = 1:3 curve
nodes.description: Green line showing break-even around 25% win rate for 1:3 risk-reward ratio

nodes.label: R:R = 1:5 curve
nodes.description: Blue line showing highest returns even at low win rates for 1:5 risk-reward ratio
